title: Candy Cloud Sorceress
description: A blue-haired female character in a purple and green bodysuit stands confidently on a glowing pink swirling candy platform suspended in the sky. She is surrounded by a massive transparent bubble containing floating lollipops, macarons, jelly beans, and various sweets, set against a dreamy pastel sky with clouds and light rays.
prompt: A confident female character with bright blue hair wearing a purple and green futuristic bodysuit stands on a large glowing pink spiral candy platform floating above clouds. She is enclosed in a giant transparent bubble filled with floating lollipops, macarons, jelly beans and assorted sweets drifting around her. Dreamy pastel pink and purple sky with soft clouds and golden light rays, whimsical surreal fantasy scene, vibrant colors, detailed digital painting.
